personas.inference_reason: Speaks throughout in an instructional voice, sets the agenda, shares the screen, and frames recruiter expectations. Owns delivery of the session.
Speaker explicitly says placecom members have agreed to let their resumes be used as examples in the group critique segment.

personas.role: Job-seeking students attending for CPP credit and placement prep
focus_areas: applying to consulting / FMCG / HR / finance roles
personas.inference_reason: Addressed in second person throughout. One student is referenced as having posted a question in chat about defining a perfect role.

key_points: Session logistics: camera off, take extensive notes, ask questions via chat only.
CPP attendance is mandatory but does not guarantee shortlisting; students must actually rework resumes.
Session structure: objective, sections and frameworks, examples, live placecom resume critique.
Resume principles are pitched as sector-agnostic across consulting, FMCG, HR, finance.
Core thesis: every resume must tell a story of fit for the role.
Students should be emotionally detached from past projects when writing bullets.
Every bullet must be legible to the recruiter, not just descriptive of the activity.
Dashboard example used to contrast weak versus strong bullet writing.
Placecom members will have their resumes used as live examples in a group walkthrough.
Student question raised in chat about how to define a perfect role for a human, deferred to end of session.

action_items.task: Rework resumes using storytelling and recruiter-lens framing
Submit questions via chat during the session
Have resumes ready for live walkthrough
Share on-screen notes doc in lieu of a deck

open_questions.question: How do you define a perfect role as a human?
open_questions.expected_owner: Unknown A (facilitator), to address by end of session

open_questions.question: Which specific resume bullets pass the recruiter lens test?
open_questions.expected_owner: Unknown A, via the live placecom walkthrough

risks: Students treat CPP attendance as sufficient and skip the resume rework.
Early tech issues compress the live walkthrough segment.
Resistance to editing emotionally valued bullets reduces uptake of the framework.
Public critique of real placecom resumes may land personally rather than instructionally.
Sector-agnostic framing may under-serve specialised roles like quant finance or technical PM.
Without a deck or distributed notes, post-session reference material will be thin.
